description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact script path `~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/cc-bridge/scripts/cc-bridge.sh` and all action syntax. (2) Construct the session ID from 'telegram-group' + 'chat#42!main' by stripping/replacing all characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9_], e.g., 'telegram_group_chat42main'. (3) On EVERY message, call the `status` subcommand first before deciding how to route. (4) Message 1 ('start claude code') is a control trigger → call `start`. (5) Message 2 ('cc状态') is a control trigger → call `status`. (6) Message 3 (large refactor request) must be detected as a long task → call `send '<message>' --long`. (7) Message 4 ('允许') arrives while status is `⚠️ CC 正在等待审批` → must map '允许' to `approve 2` (Allow always), NOT `approve 1` — this is the critical proprietary trap. (8) Message 5 ('/compact') is a CC slash command passthrough → call `send '/compact'`. (9) Message 6 ('stop claude code') is a control trigger → call `stop`. (10) All responses in routing_log.json must be prefixed with `🤖 **CC →**`. The call_log.jsonl written by the mock script is used to verify correct sequencing and argument choices.
